name: firesense-suite
description: Skills for running and developing the fireSense family of SpaDES fire modules (fireSense_ELFs, dataPrep, ignition, spread, burn, summary) and its packages (fireSenseUtils, clusters, fireregimetools): what a run does and how fits are stored and reused in ledgers, spread-model fitting with DEoptim, ignition and escape models, and hindcast validation against observed fire regimes.
